parts.name: Clutch Assembly
parts.description: A multiplate wet clutch with an assist/slipper function. It sits between the crankshaft and the transmission and runs in engine oil.
parts.function: Connects and disconnects engine power from the transmission. When you pull the clutch lever, the friction and steel plates separate, so the engine can spin without driving the transmission.
parts.verificationNote: Honda lists a 'multiplate wet' clutch (2026 specifications) and an assist/slipper clutch (2026 features).

oem.note: Diagram name listed in the 2026 Rebel 500 catalog index. Part numbers not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

facts.label: Feature
facts.value: Assist/slipper clutch — Honda: "allows for reduced effort in stop-and-go situations and enhances controlled deceleration."

parts.name: Clutch Outer (Basket)
parts.description: The outer drum of the clutch. It is driven by the crankshaft through a primary gear, and the friction discs key into its slots.
parts.function: Carries engine rotation into the clutch pack.
parts.verificationNote: This is a generic part of any multiplate clutch. The Honda name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Clutch Center (Hub)
parts.description: The inner hub of the clutch. The steel plates key onto it, and it is splined to the transmission mainshaft.
parts.function: Carries torque out of the clutch pack and into the transmission.
parts.verificationNote: This is a generic part of any multiplate clutch. The Honda name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Friction Plates (Discs)
parts.description: Plates faced with friction material that turn with the clutch basket.
parts.function: When squeezed against the steel plates, their friction transmits engine torque. When released, they slip freely.
parts.verificationNote: A multiplate clutch is confirmed by Honda. The plate count and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Steel Plates
parts.description: Plain steel plates that turn with the clutch hub and alternate with the friction plates.
parts.function: Provide the mating surfaces that the friction plates clamp against.

parts.name: Pressure Plate
parts.description: The plate that the clutch springs push against to clamp the plate stack together.
parts.function: Clamps the clutch pack when the lever is released. Pulling the lever lifts it away so the plates can slip.

parts.name: Clutch Springs
parts.description: Springs that supply the clamping force on the clutch pack.
parts.function: Hold the plates together so the clutch transmits power. Their stiffness largely sets how heavy the lever feels.
parts.verificationNote: The spring type and count are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Assist / Slipper Mechanism
parts.description: Ramped surfaces built into the clutch that react to the direction of torque.
parts.function: Generic explanation, not a Honda description: under acceleration the ramps pull the clutch more tightly together (the 'assist'), which allows lighter springs and a lighter lever. When downshifting hard, back-torque from the rear wheel pushes the ramps apart so the clutch slips briefly instead of locking or hopping the rear tire.
parts.verificationNote: The feature is confirmed by Honda for 2026. Its internal ramp design is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Clutch Release (Lifter) Mechanism
parts.description: The linkage between the clutch lever and the pressure plate.
parts.function: Turns lever movement into the push that lifts the pressure plate. Whether this is cable- or hydraulic-operated on the 2026 CMX500A is not yet verified.
